definitionZh: 标注了重点的CSS属性的文本加亮位置。 与HTML元素所渲染的文字类似,如果没有足够的强调标记空间,则会增加行高.
sourceDefinition: The text-emphasis-position CSS property sets where emphasis marks are drawn. Similar to the text rendered by the HTML element, if there isn't enough room for emphasis marks, the line height is increased.
